Not fresh or good quality
Nov 2018 • Couples
Very disappointed with the combo meal we got - 2 rotis and 3 sides, the three sides we ordered were wedges spicy rice and roast vegetables, we got 4 wedges, and 4 tiny pieces of roast veg. The chicken was not fresh or tasty and far too oily. The ribs were tough and inedible

When first arrived we specifically asked if all the deserts were available and they said yes, so after we finished our disappointing dinner we were hoping to have a nice desert, we ordered the chocolate mint cake, only to be told 10 minutes later that they didn't have it. So we left and went to Cocotte nearby for desert - which was delish. 

Bad service, disappointing food for the high prices, will not come back

Henry T
Dear RachaelMet,

Thank you for dining at Cocorico. 

We take customers' comments seriously to make sure we deliver service and value that meet our customers' expectation. 

Regarding your comments, here are our explanation:

- Our combo is 299.000đ+ (around 12.8US$+) including 2 main rotisserie (half chicken and porchetta/pork rib), 3 side dishes and 2 sauces. With this price it also covers service, location, electricity.... 

- All our rotisserie are surely fresh and roasted within day. The oily you mentioned is from the chicken juice combining with a bit chicken fat, it's not oil, because we roast in rotisserie oven, not fry. 

- The Choco mint was our fault, we had only one left and a colleague accidentally broke a small part of it while garnishing it so we didn't want to serve you that. 

Our bistro manager was there at that time and she didn't get any complaint directly from you.

She checked your food was finished all so she assumed that everything was fine. However, it was our fault not to check with you at that time.

Best,

Vietnamese version of Poulet Rôti
Oct 2017 • Couples
Took the jalapeño 1/4 chicken, which was juicy and came with 4 sauces to choose from. The nuggets with honey as starters looked good but were very, very dry. I didn’t know you can make food that dry when you deep fry it..! The blueberry yogourt was very sweet and lacked of acidity. Overall not a good experience, as food wasn’t really worth the value. Not sure I would come back. Thanks to the different spicy sauces that saved the meal in flavor. It is a goofy attempt of providing French food to Vietnamese people, or maybe adapted food for Vietnamese taste. Only locals were having lunch when we visited the restaurant.

The best roasted chicken in town
Feb 2014 • Friends
This one has a perfect balance of open rotisserie, great seasoning, tasty sides at a great price. Perfectly cooked, with crisped skin (and all the fat rendered away), and juicy, moist white meat and dark meat. Two sauces on the side: creamy mushroom sauce and red wine sauce but the creamy mushroom sauce is sure a hit (however it's not enough for the whole chicken, gotta ask for more or pay for it as a side dish)
A whole roasted chicken costs 300.000 VND ($15), enough for 3 - 4 people. 
Surprisingly great steak too ... so juicy and tender
The chicken and cabbage salad is yummy too. 
Definitely a great place for groups.Very friendly and attentive staff.
